title: AdaptiveStep: Automatically Dividing Reasoning Step through Model Confidence
authors_zh: Yuliang Liu、Junjie Lu、Zhaoling Chen、Chaofeng Qu、Jason Klein Liu、Chonghan Liu、Zefan Cai、Yunhui Xia、Li Zhao、Jiang Bian、Chuheng Zhang、Wei Shen、Zhouhan Lin
paper_type_zh: 过程与轨迹监督数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要自动分割长推理轨迹、避免固定长度或换行规则，并训练过程奖励模型的研究者。
one_line: AdaptiveStep replaces hand-written step delimiters with model-confidence boundaries, producing process-reward supervision that targets actual decision points in math and code traces.
AdaptiveStep 用模型置信度确定推理步骤边界，替代人工规则切分，使数学和代码轨迹的过程奖励对准实际决策点。
why: It makes the granularity of process supervision a learned, inspectable construction decision rather than a formatting artifact.
inclusion_reason: The official release provides reusable step- or trace-level supervision for training or evaluating reasoning verifiers and reward models.

title: Problem
问题
html:
PRMs usually segment reasoning by line breaks, sentences, or manual rules, but textual boundaries do not necessarily match internal model decisions. One key choice may span several sentences, while several decisions may occur within one sentence. A poor granularity mixes multiple inferences under one label or fragments one decision and increases rollout cost.

AdaptiveStep detects decision transitions from abrupt changes in token confidence and estimates values from these adaptive prefixes, producing process-reward data aligned with model states.

PRM 通常按换行、句号或人工规则切分步骤，但文本边界不一定对应模型内部决策：一个关键选择可能跨越多句，也可能在一句中发生多次。错误的粒度会把多个推断混成一个标签，或把同一决策拆得过细，增加 rollout 成本。

AdaptiveStep 利用 token 置信度突变识别模型决策转折，再从这些自适应前缀进行 rollout 估值，构建与模型状态相关的过程奖励数据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ASPRM Data contains about 100K training records and 215K rollout outcomes across mathematical and coding reasoning. Each record preserves the original trajectory, token probabilities, step boundaries determined by confidence changes, and prefix success rewards. It supports comparison of adaptive segmentation with sentence- or newline-based segmentation and trains ASPRM; boundaries are model-dependent rather than fixed textual annotations.
ASPRM Data 约含 10 万条训练记录和 21.5 万个 rollout 结果，覆盖数学与代码推理。每条记录保存原始轨迹、token 概率、由置信度变化确定的步骤边界及前缀成功率奖励。该数据用于比较自适应切步与句子/换行切步，并训练 ASPRM；边界会随基础模型变化，不是固定文本标注。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Generate trajectories: Sample complete reasoning trajectories for mathematics and code while preserving token probabilities.
  1. Detect boundaries: Identify decision shifts from confidence changes and segment trajectories into adaptive steps.
  1. Estimate rewards: Continue rollouts from each step prefix and use outcome success rates as process rewards.
  1. Train the verifier: Build roughly 100K training records; reproduction must fix the model, confidence threshold, rollout count, and random seed.

1. 生成轨迹：从数学和代码任务采样完整推理，并保存 token 概率。
  1. 检测边界：依据置信度突变识别模型决策转折，将轨迹切成自适应步骤。
  1. 估计奖励：从每个步骤前缀继续 rollout，以结果成功率生成过程奖励。
  1. 训练验证器：构建约 10 万训练记录；复现需固定模型、置信度阈值、rollout 次数和随机种子。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Under the same trajectories and rollout budget, adaptive boundaries align better with confidence transitions than newline or sentence segmentation and improve step-reward learning and downstream reasoning. Analysis shows that coarse segmentation hides local errors, while overly fine segmentation increases noise and estimation cost. This supports model-dependent granularity, but boundaries cannot be transferred unchanged to a different base model.
在相同轨迹和 rollout 预算下，自适应边界比换行或句子切分更贴近模型置信度转折，并提高步骤奖励学习与下游推理表现。分析表明，过粗切分会隐藏局部错误，过细切分则增加噪声与估值成本。该证据支持模型相关粒度，但换基础模型后原边界不能直接复用。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing segmentation treats linguistic punctuation as the reasoning unit. AdaptiveStep instead defines boundaries from the model’s own confidence changes, making a step correspond to when the model changes its decision rather than when the text starts a new line. The novelty is automatic, model-conditioned definition of the step object; rollout valuation and PRM training remain standard components.
已有步骤划分把语言标点视为推理单元，AdaptiveStep 改用模型自身置信度变化定义边界，使步骤反映“模型何时改变判断”而非“文本何时换行”。新意在步骤对象的自动、模型条件化定义；rollout 估值和 PRM 训练仍是常见组件。

title: Limitations
局限
html: First, token confidence does not necessarily represent a semantic decision; formatting symbols or rare words can also create abrupt changes, so agreement with human reasoning units should be measured. Second, boundaries depend on the specific model and decoding configuration and must be recomputed after model updates. Third, rewards still come from terminal rollouts and cannot eliminate correct-answer but invalid-process false positives.
第一，token 置信度未必代表语义决策，格式符号或罕见词也会造成突变；应检查边界与人工推理单元的一致性。第二，边界依赖具体模型和解码设置，模型更新后需全部重算。第三，奖励仍由终局 rollout 得到，无法消除答案正确但过程错误的假阳性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For PRM granularity research, ASPRM Data allows fixed trajectories while comparing sentence, newline, and confidence boundaries in label count, rollout cost, and downstream performance. Deployment on a new model requires recording its token probabilities and recalibrating the change threshold. The method is unsuitable when model probabilities are inaccessible, only a closed API is available, or static labels must be shared across models.
若研究 PRM 粒度，可用 ASPRM Data 固定轨迹，比较句子、换行和置信度边界在标签数量、rollout 成本与下游效果上的差异。部署到自有模型时，应重新记录 token 概率并校准突变阈值。无法访问模型概率、使用闭源 API，或需要跨模型共享静态标签时，该方法不合适。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Positioning: Uses token-confidence changes to determine reasoning-step boundaries automatically.
  1. Method handle: Probability logging, change detection, prefix rollouts, and PRM training.
  1. Data handle: ASPRM contains roughly 100K training records and 215K rollouts.
  1. Evidence anchor: Adaptive segmentation outperforms newline or sentence segmentation.
  1. Reuse decision: Best for granularity research; recompute boundaries after changing the base model.

1. 一句话定位：用 token 置信度变化自动决定推理步骤边界。
  1. 方法抓手：保存概率、检测突变、前缀 rollout 和 PRM 训练。
  1. 数据抓手：ASPRM 含约 10 万训练记录和 21.5 万 rollout。
  1. 证据锚点：自适应切分优于换行或句子切分。
  1. 复用决定：适合粒度研究；换基础模型后必须重算边界。
